title: etzhayyim docs relation graph (graph.jsonld)
description: Schema for 90-docs/_registry/graph.jsonld — the JSON-LD relation-graph projection regenerated from docs.json by 70-tools/scripts/docs/regen-graph-jsonld.py. Refreshed cycle 50 (2026-05-27) to match real data: camelCase JSON-LD predicate names, schema.org + etzhayyim ontology, all 10 doc_type values mapped to TechArticle/Article. Source chain: .md → docs.json → graph.jsonld.

@context.description: JSON-LD context preserved verbatim from existing graph.jsonld so downstream SPARQL queries + IRI mappings stay stable.

id.description: Prefixed IRI mapping to docs.json entry id.

type.description: schema.org type. TechArticle for adr/reference/how-to/design/etc; Article for explanation/tutorial.

status.description: Governance-evolving status field (same value space as docs.json status; see docs.schema.json for permissive rationale).

related.description: schema.org isRelatedTo; single string OR list of doc: IRIs.

lastVerified.description: ISO 8601 date or datetime (matches docs.schema.json last_verified). Free-form annotations after the date are flagged as errors.
